Meet the Minds Behind the Magic: Disney Worldbuilders Premieres August 20 on Disney+

Academy Award®- and Emmy®-nominated filmmaker Leslie Iwerks’ new film includes interviews with Disney Legends Bob Iger, James Cameron, and Jon Favreau, as well as Kevin Feige, Jennifer Lee, Pete Docter, Dave Filoni, Jared Bush, and Josh D’Amaro—plus a look at new worlds on the way!

The post Meet the Minds Behind the Magic: <em>Disney Worldbuilders</em> Premieres August 20 on Disney+ appeared first on D23.
